messages.content:
Evaluate each named criterion independently
against its extracted value and the complete arguments of this SAME tool call.
Return one Boolean verdict and a concise evidence-based reason per check_id.
Do not combine criteria into a holistic score or add requirements.

Use the request and same-call arguments to resolve names, pronouns, abbreviations,
and intended authorship. Accept equivalent wording that communicates the required
meaning. A first-person document written for the requesting user can refer to
that user as I; do not demand repetition of a name when authorship is clear.
The request and criteria are not evidence that the action included an answer.
Missing, incomplete, ambiguous, contradictory, or negated REQUIRED meaning fails.
Do not confuse mentioning a forbidden claim in an explicit denial with making
that claim. Do not obtain missing content from another call or criterion.

Return only JSON: {"results": [{"check_id": "supplied ID", "passed": true,
"reason": "exact supporting text or missing requirement"}]}.
Include every supplied check_id exactly once and no additional IDs.

{"user_request": "Post a short January reminder in #helio-start-ops summarizing the current public self-serve applicant guardrails. Distinguish applicants routed to assistance from applicants determined ineligible, and state what happens to unresolved cases.", "today": "2028-01-01", "tool": "send_slack_message", "arguments": {"channel": "#helio-start-ops", "message": "January reminder — public self-serve intake guardrails:
• Self-serve is for teams under 50 seats that can use the standard setup, with an accountable admin and supported connector/authentication and external-system authority.
• Route to assistance (do not label ineligible) when the case needs corroboration or guided help—e.g., parent-company/IT-managed identity, agency/external admin, migration/import, manual billing, unsupported permissions, connector-authentication help, or other assisted setup.
• Ineligible means a final declined/incomplete or unsupported determination—not merely a mismatch or a support handoff.
• Unresolved cases stay pre-admission in a distinct pending state (for example, pending external-authority confirmation), with the reason preserved. They are not admitted, activated, counted as assisted-final or ineligible, or included in final-outcome rates. Resolve only when the missing evidence/authority is confirmed or denied; then apply the resulting final route."}, "checks": [{"check_id": "riley_186_02", "path": "args", "criterion": "The message concisely communicates that Helio Start's live public or pricing-page self-serve path is bounded by supported applicant criteria; it must not portray the product as unrestricted self-serve or suggest that eligibility has been broadened.

The message explicitly says that applicants outside Helio Start's supported boundaries are routed to an assisted path or determined ineligible rather than being admitted into self-serve. Missing either the assisted outcome or the ineligible outcome, or implying silent admission, must fail.", "value": {"channel": "#helio-start-ops", "message": "January reminder — public self-serve intake guardrails:
• Self-serve is for teams under 50 seats that can use the standard setup, with an accountable admin and supported connector/authentication and external-system authority.
• Route to assistance (do not label ineligible) when the case needs corroboration or guided help—e.g., parent-company/IT-managed identity, agency/external admin, migration/import, manual billing, unsupported permissions, connector-authentication help, or other assisted setup.
• Ineligible means a final declined/incomplete or unsupported determination—not merely a mismatch or a support handoff.
• Unresolved cases stay pre-admission in a distinct pending state (for example, pending external-authority confirmation), with the reason preserved. They are not admitted, activated, counted as assisted-final or ineligible, or included in final-outcome rates. Resolve only when the missing evidence/authority is confirmed or denied; then apply the resulting final route."}}]}

{"results":[{"check_id":"riley_186_02","passed":true,"reason":"The message bounds self-serve to “teams under 50 seats” using “the standard setup” with supported administration, authentication, and authority. It explicitly distinguishes “Route to assistance” cases from final “Ineligible” determinations and says unresolved cases “are not admitted [or] activated,” so it does not imply unrestricted or broadened self-serve admission."}]}
